Gold.note: Central bank buying and rate cut expectations underpin prices despite high absolute levels.

Silver.note: Strong industrial solar demand combined with high beta to gold's monetary premium.

Copper.note: Tight mine supply and robust grid and AI infrastructure demand offset macro headwinds.

Uranium.note: Structural supply deficit and renewed global nuclear capacity build-outs drive long-term contracting.

Lithium.note: Near-term oversupply and slowing EV growth rates pressure prices despite long-term deficits.

Nickel.note: Surging Indonesian supply and a shift toward LFP batteries outweigh stainless steel demand.

Zinc.note: Significant mine supply disruptions and tight treatment charges support prices.

Iron Ore.note: Weak Chinese property sector offsets infrastructure stimulus, capping upside.

Coal.note: Thermal coal demand faces structural decline and ample global inventories.

Rare Earths.note: Opaque pricing and export controls balance against steady EV motor demand.

Manganese.note: Steady steelmaking demand is currently balanced by adequate global supply.

PGM.note: Platinum substitution in auto-catalysts and hydrogen potential offset internal combustion engine decline.

Potash.note: Normalized global supply balances steady agricultural application rates.

Aluminum.note: Chinese smelter capacity caps and low-carbon transition demand tighten the market.

Diversified.note: Balanced exposure to bullish copper and gold offsets softer iron ore and coal.
